Remark
[uniform small-scale norms on compact classes]

Source: petersen:page-0453 ↗ def:pet-ch11-cmalpha-norm-global 1. ch11:11.6.9For a class $\mathcal{M}$ of compact Riemannian $n$-manifolds compact in the $C^{m,\alpha }$ topology, show there is $f(r)\to 0$ as $r\to 0$, depending on $\mathcal{M}$, with $\| (M,g)\| _{C^{m,\alpha },r}\le f(r)$ for all $M\in \mathcal{M}$.
